groups.activity: complete Vox Solaris; reach Mastery Rank 3

rows.label: Vox Solaris
rows.note: required; grants the loaner Bondi K-Drive

rows.label: Mastery Rank 3
rows.note: required for the Waverider inbox message

conditions: You do not need to own or build a K-Drive. The loaner Bondi board is on the gear wheel, not in the Arsenal.
The Waverider is solo-only. Start it from the Codex after the inbox message arrives, then speak to Boon.

rows.label: comic pages
rows.note: unlock all three feats on each page

rows.label: Yareli Blueprint
rows.note: mailed by Grandmother after the quest

conditions: The current quest has 15 challenges, not the 25 shown in pre-Update-34 guides.
Races appear on the map only while standing on a K-Drive; race gates alone satisfy the race-point requirements, so prioritize long open races.
For the five-second airtime and difficult chain feats, archwing high up, dismount with melee, then summon the K-Drive mid-air. Bind it to a gear hotkey first.
The Pearl's circular rim and the coolant-tower roots are forgiving combo spots. On the pipe behind Fortuna, grind, charge-jump, rotate, and land back on the pipe.
Switch to secondary while riding for kill challenges. For slam kills, jump, tap crouch, then hold crouch until landing; unshielded Grineer or Infested are easier targets.
bonuses: A custom moddable board makes pages 3-5 much easier: Air Time, Primo Flair, Inertia Dampeners, Mag Locks, Perfect Balance, and Pop Top are the useful mods.
Take trick feats in short sessions. Repeating one trick more than three times stops advancing a chain, and the combo meter can expire even without a wipeout.

disclosures.title: skill gate, not a drop farm
disclosures.body: There is no part-drop RNG and no replay route. The quest yields only Yareli's main blueprint; the three component blueprints come separately from a clan's Ventkids' Bash Lab.

conditions: The Bash Lab is its own dojo room, not the Tenno, Energy, Bio, or Chem Lab. Verify it through dojo fast travel before joining a clan for Yareli.
If your clan has not researched them, each component needs 1,500 clan affinity, 72 hours, and a Detonite Injector, Mutagen Mass, or Fieldron respectively before it can be bought.
Start or locate the lab research early: it is independent of finishing The Waverider.
The remaining component materials are 150 Plastids, 875 Salvage, 350 Circuits, 1,500 Nano Spores, 350 Cryotic, and 1,750 Alloy Plate.
Nitain is the availability gate: get it from Nightwave early if it is offered. Farm Argon only after the Neuroptics blueprint is in hand.
Component blueprints take 12 hours each. The final build takes 72 hours after all three components are claimed.
